key_insight: Machine learning can extrapolate gate sequences and parameters from holographic quantum circuits to construct longer or more expressive circuits.
engineering_relevance: Reusing measured and reset qubits enables sampling from large quantum states with fixed qubit resources, while additional ancilla qubits exponentially increase the effective bond dimension.
method: Couple reusable physical qubits to persistent ancilla qubits.
Learn circuit syntax, including gates, measurements, and resets, alongside rotation parameters.
Extrapolate learned structure and parameters to longer or more expressive circuits.
evidence_signal: The methodology is demonstrated on an analytically solvable dataset based on a vector-valued generalization of the W-state; the abstract reports no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the solvable dataset and robustness to hardware measurement and reset errors remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: A machine learning architecture for scaling of holographic quantum circuits
